science.title: Probiotic may protect against recurrent respiratory tract infections in healthy adults
science.description: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial found that daily supplementation with Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus CRL 1505 significantly reduced the recurrence and total number of upper respiratory tract infections (URTI) in healthy adults compared to placebo. The probiotic group also had longer periods between infections and a lower need for over-the-counter medication, though no difference in salivary IgA levels or severity of each infection was observed. These findings expand the evidence for CRL 1505’s immune health benefits from children to adults and suggest its potential in supporting respiratory health.
